youtube_description:
Create stunning Powerpoint slides using text - with minimal effort. It is called typographic art. Learn the core concept in this short video.  Important thing to remember. DO NOT use the default text-boxes which appear in slides. Delete them, add your own text-box or shape and then type text in it.

If you do this on a regular basis, click on the below link to download my ready-made macro which will split text into word or character automatically: http://efficiency365.com/2016/01/29/split-text-into-words-or-characters-macro/

Dr. Nitin Paranjape (Office MVP)
